$comment: Copy to ~/.skein/config.json (or point $SKEIN_CONFIG at it). Specs and blocks name models as "provider/model"; baseUrl and apiKey are resolved from here when a model thread starts and are never written into the graph.

ripper.$comment: Any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint. apiKey is optional; models is the list offered to lenses.

defaults.$comment: Used when a spec omits them. thinking: off | low | medium | high.
